greeting: You survived the prologue. I was beginning to think the door had scared you off.
promise_greeting: Midnight is still on, then. Try not to sound so nervous when you ask about the gateway.

topics.label: Blame matchmaking
topics.text: Matchmaking is a cursed art. Last night my team defended the wrong tower with the conviction of people who had never seen a map. I am not angry. I am composing a ballad.

topics.label: Ask about the photo
topics.text: The street photo? I took it from the old bridge. The bridge is not old, and there is no bridge there now. You see why I keep it off my page.

topics.label: Talk fashion
topics.text: Salma says velvet is having a moment. Salma also says pineapple belongs on pizza, so we choose which advice to ignore. The jacket survived the shoot, by the way. Barely.

topics.label: Share music
topics.text: Tonight I am listening to something slow and dramatic. It is either the soundtrack to a doomed romance or a perfume advertisement. The difference is mostly the budget.

topics.label: Ask about Nocturne
topics.text: Nocturne has cities older than your maps and people who would sell their own shadows for a secret. That is all you get tonight. Curiosity is good; wandering is not.

topics.label: Check in
topics.text: You can tell me to change the subject, you know. I tease because it is easier than saying I am glad you are still here. That is not a demand. Just a confession, unfortunately.

fallbacks.game: If this is about Mobile Legends, the answer is that the game is rigged and my team is a public hazard. Send the match ID and I will pretend to be objective.
fallbacks.nocturne: I told you: doors, old cities, bad politics. Ask me something smaller. Fashion. Music. Why Salma's playlists are superior. Those I can explain without a map.
fallbacks.photo: Some photographs are memories. Some are warnings. That one was both, and I am not ready to tell you which came first.
fallbacks.music: Depends on the mood. Do you want doom, dancing, or the specific sadness of a train leaving at 2 a.m.? Choose one and I will send something dangerous.
fallbacks.hello: Hello to you too. You are very formal for someone who has seen my terrible camera roll.
fallbacks.default: I am listening. Though if this is you trying to extract supernatural secrets, your technique needs work. Ask me about the photo, the game, or Salma's questionable fashion advice.
